_doc: Single source of truth for signal-agent strategy onboarding.
Edit this file (or use register_strategy.py CLI) to add or disable strategies.
registry_loader.py reads this; run_signals.py and regime/regime_rules.py derive STRATEGY_MAP and ALL_STRATEGIES from it.
Fields per entry:
id          : integer, must be unique. Used as the strategy_id in gold.strategy_signals.
name        : short label shown in dashboards and logs.
class_path  : 'module.path:ClassName' — must be importable from the agents/signals/ root.
tier        : one of {experimental, near_golden, golden}. Mirrors gold.strategy_registry.priority
(EXPERIMENTAL/NEAR_GOLDEN/GOLDEN) and MUST match the folder the file lives in:
strategies/<tier>/strategy_NN.py. Promotion = git mv the file + update tier +
class_path here + update the DB row, one commit.
regime      : one of {TREND, MEAN_REV, CARRY, EVENT, FLAT}. Decides when the strategy is gated active.
enabled     : true = run in daily cron and write signals. false = imported only, NEVER writes signals.
asset_class : {equity, crypto, fx, commodity}. Used for filtering and reporting.
params      : free-form dict the strategy class reads (basket, lookback windows, thresholds...).
Strategies that don't yet read from params still work — they ignore this field.
notes       : human-readable history / TODO.
2026-07-10: removed the 13 permanently-disabled stub entries (ids 3,4,5,7,8,9,10,12,13,14,17,19,20)
and strategies/stubs.py. They were idea placeholders with no implementation; the same strategy ideas
are now tracked as real rows in the gold.strategy_registry DB table (PEAD, BTC funding carry, COT
fade/contrarian, etc.), so keeping a second, dead copy here was pure duplication. Historical ids stay
retired — register new strategies with fresh ids to avoid colliding with old gold.strategy_signals rows.
2026-10-09: legacy audit (qr_research) governance labels — optional field 'execution_status':
OBSERVE_ONLY = enabled, signals logged to gold.strategy_signals + gold.regime_gate_decision_log,
but NO order consumer may be wired without a SIM->PAPER gate pass. DISABLED = enabled:false.
id 1 DISABLED; ids 2,6,11,15,16,18 OBSERVE_ONLY (id 11 also untradeable at book NAV).
